subject: Interim payment cadence and VAT routing for pilot - conditional advance request
messages:
From: Emma Chen <emma@cloudscale.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Brenner <tom.brenner@cloudscale.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: interim payment cadence and VAT handling for pilot

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week — the team is excited to move our pilot to the next phase. Before we sign the SOW we need to align on two operational items on payments/tax so procurement can issue a PO:

- Cashflow: our treasury has a month-end remit window and prefers Net30, but we can be flexible if Redwood can accommodate a short advance or tranche schedule to cover initial cloud & tooling spends.
- VAT / tax: we are EU-registered but use a UK subsidiary for some contracts; we need confirmation on whether Redwood will invoice to CloudScale UK (VAT reverse charge) or our NL entity.

Can Redwood propose an interim payment cadence that reduces our short-term working capital need (we're comfortable with a partial advance) and also confirm the VAT billing flow? If you can send a one-pager or amendment with the proposed schedule I can get procurement to raise a PO this week.

Attaching our Q2 spend report for context.

Thanks,
Emma
Emma Chen
Head of Procurement, CloudScale Analytics
emma@cloudscale.ai
Attachment: CloudScale_Spend_Report_Q2.csv (CSV)
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@cloudscale.ai>
Cc: Tom Brenner <tom.brenner@cloudscale.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: interim payment cadence and VAT handling for pilot

Hi Emma — great to hear, and thanks for the spend file.

High level proposal from Redwood:
- Conditional advance: 20% of the first-month estimated invoice as a non-refundable/settled advance applied to the first invoice. This reduces your immediate net cash outlay while keeping our unit economics protected.
- Remainder on Net45 from invoice date for the pilot (we can do Net30 for later production contracts once credit checks complete).
- Credit cap: initial committed credit corridor of EUR 250,000 while the pilot is live (we can revisit after 60 days).
- VAT routing: we can invoice CloudScale UK Ltd (reverse charge) if you provide VAT ID + certificate; otherwise we will invoice CloudScale NL BV and charge VAT where applicable. Please confirm preferred billing entity.

Needed from you to finalize today:
1) Preferred billing entity and VAT ID (or certificate).
2) Procurement PO number (we can attach an amendment to the SOW and DocuSign).

I attached a short terms amendment that reflects the conditional advance and credit cap. If that looks OK, I'll send DocuSign to the procurement contact and loop in finance to open the credit corridor.

Next steps I propose: I’ll queue DocuSign for the amendment today and Karthik/Rishi will run a quick credit check. If procurement can confirm PO this week we can start the pilot on Tuesday.

Best,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_Terms_Amendment_v1.pdf (PDF)
From: Emma Chen <emma@cloudscale.ai>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Brenner <tom.brenner@cloudscale.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 13:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: interim payment cadence and VAT handling for pilot

Thanks Priya — this is broadly workable. Procurement will issue PO #4509 in the UK entity if we can get the reverse-charge flow documented (VAT ID below). We can accept 20% advance applied to month 1.

CloudScale billing details:
- Billing entity: CloudScale UK Ltd
- VAT ID: GB123456789

I'll attach the PO in a follow-up. Can you send the DocuSign link for the amendment and confirm Redwood's AR contact for remittance advice?

Cheers,
Emma
Attachment: CloudScale_PO_4509.pdf (PDF)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: internal: credit guardrails suggestion re CloudScale pilot

Priya / Rishi — internal note (please keep off external threads):

I ran the quick credit check on CloudScale and their payment score is OK but their spend profile has month-end peaks (see attached Emma file). A couple of recommendations:
- Add a 30-day escrow-style holdback equal to 10% of monthly invoice for the first two months, released after no late payments. This protects Redwood in case of delayed remits.
- Limit advance to 20% as proposed, and require PO + billing entity confirmation before advance is applied.
- If procurement prefers Net30 we can agree Net30 but reduce the credit cap to EUR 150k initially. For Net45 we can stick with EUR 250k.

If you want to proceed with the 20% advance + Net45 + EUR 250k cap I’m comfortable, provided finance sets up the holdback release rules.

-Karthik
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma@cloudscale.ai>, Tom Brenner <tom.brenner@cloudscale.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: interim payment cadence and VAT handling for pilot

Emma / Tom — thanks for the VAT ID and PO. Confirming next steps so procurement has everything they need: 

1) DocuSign: I’ve sent the Redwood Terms Amendment (reflects 20% conditional advance, Net45 remainder, EUR 250,000 temporary credit cap, 10% two-month holdback) to the procurement contact at CloudScale. Link: https://www.docusign.com/console/documents/ABC-RED-2026-0421
2) Invoicing: Redwood will invoice CloudScale UK Ltd (reverse charge) once we receive the VAT certificate and PO #4509. Please upload the VAT certificate to the DocuSign extras or reply-all with the attachment.
3) Finance ops: Karthik/Rishi — please open the EUR 250k temporary credit corridor and configure the 10% release rule for two billing periods. Priya will confirm when DocuSign completes.

Emma — once DocuSign is signed we’ll apply the 20% advance as a credit on month 1 and send the formal invoice schedule. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
